draft.subject: Your downgrade question, and a first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks for your question about downgrade timing — your ticket is still open and a colleague is reviewing it, so you'll get a clear answer there rather than a guess from me.

In the meantime, your workspace is ready whenever you are. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and set up that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
